verdict.headline: NO_GO
verdict.summary: M325 proves the exact M321 RTL equivalent to the exact M322 mapped netlist. M326 independently preserves the +1.1047 ns setup result but finds -0.0071 ns hold WNS, about -0.20 ns reported TNS and 82 violating endpoints out of 156; therefore the combined 3 ns timing gate is fail-closed NO-GO.

limits: This is not a proof against the one-cycle M311 latency contract.
This does not prove timing, reset recovery/removal, power, SRAM, complete Conv, accuracy or system performance.

hold.count_reconciliation: 82/156 is the authoritative coverage/global endpoint count. The 28 entries in ptsta_timing_hold.rpt are only paths emitted under -max_paths 100 and -nworst 10.

asynchronous_reset.constraint: set_false_path -from [get_ports reset_n] after mapped SDC load
asynchronous_reset.interpretation: The reviewed data-path setup/hold result excludes asynchronous-reset timing; reset recovery/removal is not signed off.

findings.title: Fast-corner hold fails on 82 of 156 endpoints
findings.evidence: PrimeTime reports hold WNS -0.0071 ns, global TNS -0.20 ns and 82 reg-to-reg violating endpoints; setup remains +1.1047 ns.
findings.impact: The M326 hold-nonnegative gate and the combined 3 ns timing bundle fail. Tool exit code zero only means PrimeTime completed; it is not timing closure.
findings.required_fix: Apply a bounded min-delay/hold ECO or resynthesis, then satisfy every item in minimum_hold_fix_readmission before replacing NO-GO with GO.

findings.title: Reset recovery/removal is intentionally outside the timing proof
findings.evidence: reset_n is the only no-input-delay port and is false-pathed from the input; all 156 recovery and 156 removal checks are untested because no reset startpoint clock is modeled.
findings.impact: Even after data-path hold repair, the result can only be called prelayout functional-data timing under the disclosed reset exception, not reset signoff or physical timing closure.
findings.required_fix: For physical signoff, define the reset-release architecture and constrain/check recovery and removal. Until then preserve this exact exception and state the exclusion explicitly.

findings.title: The M326 receipt omits the authoritative hold population
findings.evidence: The receipt stores hold_met=null and a boolean authoritative flag, whereas report_analysis_coverage contains 74 met and 82 violated of 156.
findings.impact: A reader using only the receipt misses that 52.6% of register hold endpoints fail and may confuse the 28 printed timing paths with the endpoint population.
findings.required_fix: Emit hold_total=156, hold_met=74, hold_violated=82, hold_untested=0, WNS and TNS directly into the next receipt.

findings.title: The reset exception is applied but the exception report does not enumerate it
findings.evidence: The exact TCL and raw log show set_false_path from reset_n, while ptsta_exceptions.rpt was generated with -ignored and is empty except for the report header.
findings.impact: The exception can be reconstructed from exact-SHA script/log evidence, but the report set does not independently list active exceptions or prove a one-exception cardinality.
findings.required_fix: In the re-run, emit active exception objects/counts and fail if any false-path or multicycle exception exists beyond the single reviewed reset_n source exception.

findings.title: Non-fatal methodology warnings should be closed or explicitly waived
findings.evidence: PrimeTime warns that SDC 2.1 differs from requested 2.2. Formality reports 375 unlinked power cells and notes that no guide_hier_map commands were present, although 352 SVF commands were accepted and equivalence succeeded.
findings.impact: These warnings do not overturn the scoped Formality result or cause the observed hold failure, but leaving them unexplained weakens a paper-facing reproducibility package.
findings.required_fix: Align the SDC version, preserve a warning waiver/explanation for library power cells, and enable or explicitly waive hierarchical mapping guidance in the next sealed flow.

minimum_hold_fix_readmission: Create a new exact-SHA mapped/ECO netlist and mapped SDC; never overwrite M322/M325/M326 evidence.
Preserve M321 externally visible semantics, two-cycle no-stall latency and ready-ready II=1; rerun directed VCS if RTL changes.
Run fresh RTL-to-fixed-netlist Formality with verify_return=1, all compare points passing, and zero failing, aborted, unverified and unmatched points.
Run fresh PrimeTime with the same 3.000 ns clock, ssg0p9v125c setup library, ffg1p05vm40c min library, input/output assumptions and exactly the reviewed reset_n exception; add no timing-waiver trick.

Require setup WNS at least +0.5000 ns to retain the M322 architecture gate, hold WNS at least 0.0000 ns, hold TNS 0.0000 ns, and 0 violating hold endpoints out of all 156; all synchronous setup/hold checks must be tested.
Require no unconstrained synchronous data endpoints and no new false-path, multicycle or disabled-timing exceptions; enumerate the active reset exception in a machine-readable receipt.
Rehash and seal the fixed netlist, SDC, libraries, tools/scripts, Formality reports, PT reports and receipt; replay both manifests before admission.
Report post-fix area/cell/delay-cell deltas and retain prelayout/no-SPEF/ideal-clock/zero-macro boundaries. Physical or paper-PPA admission still requires propagated-clock post-layout analysis.

admitted: Exact M321 RTL is functionally equivalent to the exact M322 mapped netlist: 205/205 compare points pass, including 49 port and 156 DFF points.
Under the scoped M326 prelayout setup model, 156/156 setup endpoints pass with +1.1047 ns worst slack.
not_admitted: The combined 3 ns setup-plus-hold timing gate
Post-route frequency, propagated-clock timing or extracted-parasitic timing
Physical SRAM, power, energy or paper-ready PPA
Accuracy, system speedup, DATE comparison, headline or best-paper claim
